name: design-pipeline
description: The conveyor: builds a complete web surface end-to-end through ten gates, each owned by one vendor skill and each closing on a checkable artifact — intake, brief, tokens, references, art direction, wireframe, build, states, motion, SEO/CWV/a11y audit, ship verdict. Wraps ui-craft's phase commands rather than re-implementing them, and closes the four holes ui-craft leaves: intake, visual references, isolated art direction, and search/performance audit. For single-aspect passes on existing UI, install design-tools.
